w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: You catch Eamon telling the fire about Terry. "Terry came back mauled by The Redactor (15 rounds, 45 taken) and alive. A limp that comes back in the cold now." The story's already growing.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: They settled names for 2 beasts: "Ugly-Eyes", "Old Gavel".

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Focus Group.

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — Chorus Line.

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Callback.

w3Mentions.name: Buffering
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🩸 The Buffering mauled Owen (-41 health) over 3 rounds. They're lucky to be breathing.

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Ad Break is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: 💥 tiger's Rerun finds Ella — no dodging it.
firstContext: 💥 tiger's Rerun finds Ella — no dodging it.
📖 Codex: Rerun — locks onto one target — moving won't dodge it. You won't forget this.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 📖 LEARNED: Tainted Bait (Level 1). Your bait is tainted — traps catch 50% more. (The poison’s in the bait, not your hands. Mostly.)
◈ TRIAL COMPLETE — the audience applauds, which sounds like static. (+15 integration, gift: a lesson: Tainted Bait)
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
A cold snap. Breath smokes. The woods go quiet.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (21/14/8), with 4 wave-4 fought, 14 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 2 · Forage 15 · Craft 4 · Talk 24 · Explore 36 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; promises kept. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE BELOVED — "Speak for the quiet ones."
◈ THE ARCHITECT — Yuki Mori ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

firenarr.line: ⚠ The store has fallen far from its recent high again — the shelves are nearly bare.
⚠ The store keeps slipping from its recent high again — evening after evening, lower.
⚠ The store keeps slipping from its recent high again — evening after evening, lower.
⚠ The store has fallen further still from its recent high.

hurtreturn.line: 🧭 Eamon returns from the wilds hurt (health 2/100) — the trip cut short.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,374 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.

✨ CAPSTONE: Truth Lenses. The world, unredacted. Lies show up as smudges. Hidden things show up as outlines. It was never going to drop from a monster. It was always going to be GIVEN — to someone who'd earned the shape of it.
